blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 2.6
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 2.6

blocks.text: गुरुरुपायः
blocks.directed: [slowly] गुरुरुपायः

blocks.text: Gurur upāyaḥ.
blocks.directed: Gurur upāyaḥ.

blocks.text: The guru is the means.
blocks.directed: The guru is the means.

blocks.text: Unfortunately, You’re Going to Need a Guru.
blocks.directed: Unfortunately, You’re Going to Need a Guru.

blocks.text: Oh, for God’s sake.
blocks.directed: Oh, for God’s sake.

blocks.text: We’ve been doing so well.
blocks.directed: We’ve been doing so well.

blocks.text: We discovered that consciousness is the Self.
blocks.directed: We discovered that consciousness is the Self.

blocks.text: That Śakti is our own fundamental power.
blocks.directed: That Śakti is our own fundamental power.

blocks.text: That mantra is rooted in awareness.
blocks.directed: That mantra is rooted in awareness.

blocks.text: That supreme knowledge arises naturally.
blocks.directed: That supreme knowledge arises naturally.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta has decided we need another person involved.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta has decided we need another person involved.

blocks.text: Gurur upāyaḥ.
blocks.directed: Gurur upāyaḥ.

blocks.text: The guru is the means.
blocks.directed: The guru is the means.

blocks.text: Well, who’s the guru?
blocks.directed: Well, who’s the guru?

blocks.text: And why do we need one if we’re already Śiva?
blocks.directed: And why do we need one if we’re already Śiva?

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja gives a beautifully nuanced answer.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja gives a beautifully nuanced answer.

blocks.text: The guru is not merely somebody who has memorised a large quantity of Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: The guru is not merely somebody who has memorised a large quantity of Sanskrit.

blocks.text: Nor simply someone who knows how to perform a complicated ceremony.
blocks.directed: Nor simply someone who knows how to perform a complicated ceremony.

blocks.text: The genuine guru communicates the meaning of reality and reveals the potency of mantra.
blocks.directed: The genuine guru communicates the meaning of reality and reveals the potency of mantra.

blocks.text: The guru makes recognition possible through instruction and, in the tantric understanding, the operation of divine grace.
blocks.directed: The guru makes recognition possible through instruction and, in the tantric understanding, the operation of divine grace.

blocks.text: And here’s the key.
blocks.directed: And here’s the key.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja gives two related interpretations.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja gives two related interpretations.

blocks.text: First, the guru is the teacher who reveals the true meaning of the principles and practices.
blocks.directed: First, the guru is the teacher who reveals the true meaning of the principles and practices.

blocks.text: Second, the guru can be understood as the grace-bestowing power of the Supreme Lord.
blocks.directed: Second, the guru can be understood as the grace-bestowing power of the Supreme Lord.

blocks.text: This is crucial.
blocks.directed: This is crucial.

blocks.text: Because it means the ultimate efficacy of the guru isn’t reducible to their ordinary personality.
blocks.directed: Because it means the ultimate efficacy of the guru isn’t reducible to their ordinary personality.

blocks.text: The guru’s liberating function is rooted in Śakti.
blocks.directed: The guru’s liberating function is rooted in Śakti.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja invokes the Mālinīvijayatantra and other tantric authorities in explaining the relation between the guru, divine grace, and mantra’s efficacy. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja invokes the Mālinīvijayatantra and other tantric authorities in explaining the relation between the guru, divine grace, and mantra’s efficacy. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: So imagine the situation.
blocks.directed: So imagine the situation.

blocks.text: You’ve spent several years reading philosophy.
blocks.directed: You’ve spent several years reading philosophy.

blocks.text: You understand prakāśa.
blocks.directed: You understand prakāśa.

blocks.text: You understand vimarśa.
blocks.directed: You understand vimarśa.

blocks.text: You’ve learned the thirty-six tattvas.
blocks.directed: You’ve learned the thirty-six tattvas.

blocks.text: You know the difference between āṇavamala and māyīyamala.
blocks.directed: You know the difference between āṇavamala and māyīyamala.

blocks.text: You can explain the five kañcukas without accidentally confusing them with the five kośas.
blocks.directed: You can explain the five kañcukas without accidentally confusing them with the five kośas.

blocks.text: Wonderful.
blocks.directed: Wonderful.

blocks.text: You’re now an exceptionally knowledgeable individual.
blocks.directed: You’re now an exceptionally knowledgeable individual.

blocks.text: But perhaps you’ve become exceptionally knowledgeable about your own fundamental freedom without actually recognising it.
blocks.directed: But perhaps you’ve become exceptionally knowledgeable about your own fundamental freedom without actually recognising it.

blocks.text: You’re studying the map.
blocks.directed: You’re studying the map.

blocks.text: Beautiful map.
blocks.directed: Beautiful map.

blocks.text: Gorgeous contour lines.
blocks.directed: Gorgeous contour lines.

blocks.text: Very impressive bibliography.
blocks.directed: Very impressive bibliography.

blocks.text: But you haven’t arrived.
blocks.directed: But you haven’t arrived.

blocks.text: Then a genuine teacher helps you understand what the teachings are pointing towards.
blocks.directed: Then a genuine teacher helps you understand what the teachings are pointing towards.

blocks.text: Not merely by adding another concept.
blocks.directed: Not merely by adding another concept.

blocks.text: But by directing your awareness towards the very reality in which all concepts appear.
blocks.directed: But by directing your awareness towards the very reality in which all concepts appear.

blocks.text: And suddenly the knowledge changes character.
blocks.directed: And suddenly the knowledge changes character.

blocks.text: It’s no longer merely information about consciousness.
blocks.directed: It’s no longer merely information about consciousness.

blocks.text: It’s recognition.
blocks.directed: It’s recognition.

blocks.text: That is the transformative possibility of upadeśa — instruction.
blocks.directed: That is the transformative possibility of upadeśa — instruction.

blocks.text: And in the tantric framework, śaktipāta, the descent of grace, is deeply relevant.
blocks.directed: And in the tantric framework, śaktipāta, the descent of grace, is deeply relevant.

blocks.text: But we should be careful.
blocks.directed: But we should be careful.

blocks.text: This doesn’t mean that every person calling themselves a guru automatically possesses divine authority.
blocks.directed: This doesn’t mean that every person calling themselves a guru automatically possesses divine authority.

blocks.text: It certainly doesn’t mean suspending ethical judgement or surrendering autonomy to a charismatic personality.
blocks.directed: It certainly doesn’t mean suspending ethical judgement or surrendering autonomy to a charismatic personality.

blocks.text: The classical ideal is the guru who genuinely discloses reality, not somebody demanding obedience because they’ve acquired a sufficiently elaborate beard.
blocks.directed: The classical ideal is the guru who genuinely discloses reality, not somebody demanding obedience because they’ve acquired a sufficiently elaborate beard.

blocks.text: The deepest point is that Śiva’s own grace can operate through instruction.
blocks.directed: The deepest point is that Śiva’s own grace can operate through instruction.

blocks.text: Consciousness, apparently, has developed a teaching department.
blocks.directed: Consciousness, apparently, has developed a teaching department.

blocks.text: And sometimes that department takes human form.
blocks.directed: And sometimes that department takes human form.
